entities.summary: Andrew Phillip Peeke is an American professional ice hockey player who is a defenseman for the Boston Bruins of the National Hockey League (NHL). Peeke was selected 34th overall by the Columbus Blue Jackets in the 2016 NHL Entry Draft.
